page.notes: The page number "223" is printed in the top right corner. The number "1031" is printed with spaces between the digits, and "1627" and "1036" likewise. The number "30" after "sex" looks like ";o" in the scan, so it is marked [?]. The words Muharrem, Rabia, Gemadhi, Regeb, Sciaban, Ramadhan, Sceuval and Dhilcaade are set in bold type in the print; the text here is plain. The hyphens at "fe-re", "ettha-ni", "Scio-aban" and "intercalatio-ad" are printed line-end hyphens, and the scan at "intercalatio" shows a dot that is read as a hyphen. "Dhilhagge" is read as printed.
